items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: Represents the request for the OCR API.
items.translation: 代表对 OCR API 的请求。

items.source:
Represents the document to be processed, which can be either a document URL or
an image URL.
items.translation: 表示待处理的文档，可以是文档 URL 或图像 URL。

items.source: Returns a string representation of this record class. The representation contains the name of the class, followed by the name and value of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此记录类的字符串表示形式。该表示形式包含类名，随后是各记录组件的名称和值。

items.source: Returns a hash code value for this object. The value is derived from the hash code of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此对象的哈希码值。该值由每个记录组件的哈希码推导得出。

items.source: model - Model to use for OCR. Can be 'mistral-ocr-latest'
items.translation: model - 用于 OCR 的模型。可以是'mistral-ocr-latest'。

items.source: id - An optional string identifier.
items.translation: id - 可选的字符串标识符。

items.source: pages - Specific pages to process in various formats: single number, range, or list of both. Starts from 0.
items.translation: pages - 指定要处理的页面，支持多种格式：单个数字、范围或两者的组合列表。从 0 开始计数。

items.source: includeImageBase64 - Whether to include image URLs in the response.
items.translation: includeImageBase64 - 是否将图片 URL 包含在响应中。

items.source: imageLimit - Maximum number of images to extract.
items.translation: imageLimit - 提取图像的最大数量。

items.source: imageMinSize - Minimum height and width of image to extract.
items.translation: imageMinSize - 提取图像的最小高度和宽度。
